description: Find the best installable build (.apk/.aab/.ipa/.app) in Gradle/Flutter/Xcode outputs. Returns ranked candidates (build type, installability, app id, warnings) and the paths searched. Side-effect free.

allowOutsideRoot.description: Allow a candidate outside the project root.

path.description: Explicit artifact path; skips the search.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path; else the usual root resolution.

sessionId.description: Use this session's projectRoot if given.

name: qa_resolve_artifact
title: Resolve a build artifact
